# nova-tools fixes

<!-- Generated from docs/fixes.sexp by tools/roadmap. Do not edit this file: edit docs/fixes.sexp and run `make roadmap`. -->

The point releases after v1.2.2: what each one shipped, is shipping or will ship. A point release carries fixes only; new work is in ROADMAP.md. nova-sprint's point releases are in that repository's FIXES.md.

## v1.2.3 (shipped, 2026-10-10)

The split: nova-sprint, nova-card and nova-work, with their models and docs, leave this repository for mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint.

- **The sprint tools leave nova-tools** (shipped). Their commands, packages, models and docs move to mas-bandwidth/nova-sprint, and CI refuses their paths here. From: the split, layers L5 to L7; PR #5591.

## v1.2.4 (shipped, 2026-10-10)

One fix: the sprint store's function library is back at its v1.2.2 digest, so an adopt can load it.

- **Six Lua comment lines restored** (shipped). The function library's digest is its v1.2.2 value again, so the adopt's shadow tick accepts it. From: PR #5592, head 7d1dc0c06.

## v1.2.5 (in-progress)

The roadmap and this page come back as data, and the open issues move into the roadmap.

- **ROADMAP.md and FIXES.md generated from s-expression data** (in-progress). docs/roadmap.sexp and docs/fixes.sexp are the data; `make roadmap` writes both pages, and a test fails when a page differs from what its data renders. From: PR #5533.

## v1.2.6 (planned)

The fixes held during the split, the point-release candidates found on 2026-10-10, the owed tests, and the sprint store cards that are point-release work. Each is re-applied or written in this repository, then cut as one release.

- **The card tells the child its wall: deadline and temporary directory** (planned). The worker card tells the child its deadline, and the native wall passes the slot temporary directory so TMPDIR is the slot one. From: nova-tools PR #5575, head 4725d7d7d.
- **A walled lane tokens are read where its harness writes them** (shipped). Walled sessions live under the wall home, tokens are read from there first, and a session in no database is unread rather than zero, so the token cap can trip. From: nova-tools PR #5590, head 0c4fd7ea; landed in dev as 1babe4a43f via PR #5595.
- **The hosted tests are green on main and nightly** (planned). Two hosted tests are red on main and nightly (the fork bomb wall cap and jobs as worktrees of one mirror); make them pass there. From: v1.2.5 candidate list.
- **A friend AI moved to another machine uses the provider key that worked** (planned). After a move the friend AI ran with a stored provider key that differs from the working one, and the provider refused it. The stored key is replaced by the owner, then the friend AI restarts through the play. From: v1.2.5 candidate list.
- **release build refuses to ship without the sprint release** (planned). nova-update release build without --sprint-release ships no sprint tools and succeeds; it refuses unless an explicit opt-out flag is given. From: nova-tools PR #5571 cold read.
- **The release changelog lists merge-queue merges** (in-progress). The cut changelog says no pull request merged since the previous tag although the merge queue merged many; the listing includes merge-queue merges. From: v1.2.4 cut note.
- **A worker writes its result before the route deadline** (planned). Children on some direct routes work to the route deadline and never write their result file; give the route a longer deadline or reserve a margin to write the result. From: fault inventory, 2026-10-10.
- **A draining member's beat carries this tick's no-room word** (in-progress). The member asks Room every tick before the drain return, so a member that drained under its disk floor stops saying no room once the disk is freed (nova-sprint tla/NoRoom.tla, WordIsThisTicks). From: v1.2.5 candidate 5; the PR #5569 follow-up.
- **A friend's lane runs only a card the server has taken for her** (in-progress). A free lane takes its card by id and starts nothing until the take is answered OK; a refused take (the machine STOPPED) is asked again on a later pass, a batch daemon takes her ready cards, and a card set aside on a refused take or finish is taken again (tla/FriendLaneTake.tla). From: a friend host, 2026-10-10 20:14Z: a one-shot friend's 23 lanes ran ready cards and set them aside.
- **A friend's batch take names the epoch of her ready cards** (in-progress). The server refuses every worker verb that names no epoch; the batch take sent none, so a batch friend's ready cards were never taken. The take now names the newest epoch her row holds, and a lane's take names the epoch her row says for the card. From: a friend host, 2026-10-10 20:53Z: take REFUSED, a worker's verb names the epoch.
- **A friend's lane wall always has a coordinator self to deny** (in-progress). nova-friend install takes --deny-self and writes it into the agent, the seat play passes nova_friend_deny_self to a reinstall whose plist records none, and with no flag the daemon denies the seat's working root, so no lane exits 125 with bad_profile for a missing deny list. From: a one-shot friend host, 2026-10-10: every lane exit 125, the daemon ran with no --deny-self.
- **A fleet loops play refuses when its checkout version differs from the adopted release** (planned). Fleet plays run only from the checkout of the adopted release, and refuse when the checkout's version differs from the release installed on the host. From: dogfood 2026-10-10 evening: fleet-only restart.
- **A friend's lanes are thin clients of the sprint server** (in-progress). Each lane asks the server what it holds (take --lane), runs exactly that, and reports by the ids, epoch and lane the server gave; a refusal drops the job and the lane asks again. lanes.json keeps sessions and owed stop-returns only, never what a lane holds, and reads go through the same lane loop. The model is tla/FriendLane.tla. From: a one-shot friend host, 2026-10-10: took logged while the server showed the card ready, and progress sent at epoch 0.
- **A friend's lane wall reads the pinned harness it runs** (shipped). nova-friend install takes --wall-reads and writes it into the agent, and the seat play passes nova_friend_wall_reads to a reinstall whose plist records none, so a pinned harness whose shim execs a directory under the home no longer exits 126 (Operation not permitted) for every lane. From: a one-shot friend host, 2026-10-10: every lane exit 126 after the harness pin; the wall denied reading the pinned harness directory.
- **A friend's new epoch retires her older-epoch items and starts empty** (in-progress). On the sprint's new epoch the daemon moves every older-epoch inbox and outbox item to the retired folder named for its epoch, kept, never deleted, and the live folders start the new epoch empty; on the same signal the lanes forget their sessions and the present is owed, so a full or stale session never carries across a clear. From: the seat ledger v1.2.4-held-2026-10-10.md friend snap, 2026-10-10: 323 inbox items and 535 outbox REPORTs of epoch 15, each refused (not on her row).
- **A friend's lane session full or missing starts a fresh one itself** (in-progress). A provider's context-limit refusal on a lane's session, or a session the harness no longer has, no longer counts the card's turns against it and waits for a hand session plus a restart: the lane starts a fresh session itself, seeded from the friend's own files, its card continues in it (once per card; after that the refusal is the card's business again), and the seat is told once per renewal. From: the owner 2026-10-10: what else is manual that should be automatic from the machine.
